title: Ragdoll mob corpses
description: This thing just adds some stuff like cows dying physically and you can carry them home and decorate or something, recommended to bury them
body:
This mod is just for corpses to be created when the mobs die, corpses have the same health as an alive one, but turn into loots after 5 minutes, can be killed again to drop loots sooner

Cooking corpses is planned
(Please don't torture the corpses)

You hate your best companions just disappearing into *puff and want to preserve them?? Well maybe this mod does help you keep your memories


Dependencies:
- [Sable ragdolls - leonardoinc22](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable-ragdolls)
- [Sable - ryanhcode / simulated team](https://modrinth.com/mod/sable)
